```{r}
#| include: false
# One funnel page, knit as a child from experience-monitoring.qmd. The caller
# supplies `fid`, `label` and `h1` (the heading prefix: "#" for a page of its
# own, "####" for a tabset member). Chunks are unlabelled because a loop would
# emit the same label five times, and this comment sits in an include: false
# chunk because markdown ahead of the first heading renders as an empty card.

h_row <- paste0(h1, "#")
h_col <- paste0(h_row, "#")

# Here, not in the chart chunk: the chart's fig-cap is evaluated before its
# code runs, and the caption depends on the series' date range.
s7 <- task_success_series(con, fid, "7", series_start, data_through)
s1 <- task_success_series(con, fid, "1", series_start, data_through)
chart_from <- min(s7$window_end, s1$window_end)
chart_to <- max(s7$window_end, s1$window_end)
events <- funnel_annotations(annotations, fid, chart_from, chart_to)
```

`r h1` `r label`

`r h_col` Column {width="24%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Task success rate over time"
#| fig-width: 7.7
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-alt: !expr chart_alt(fid)
#| fig-cap: !expr annotation_caption(events)

p <- ggplot() +
  annotation_layers(events, chart_from, chart_to) +
  # Sized by starters, so a low-volume day draws small. No log transform:
  # the size scale already square-roots the value on its way to an area.
  geom_point(
    data = s1, aes(window_end, value, size = starters),
    colour = "grey70", alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.4, 2.4), guide = "none") +
  # Grouped by version so the line breaks where the definition changes.
  geom_line(
    data = s7, aes(window_end, value, group = funnel_version),
    colour = accent, linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
  theme_cds() +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Task success rate",
    title = chart_title(fid),
    subtitle = chart_subtitle(fid)
  )

# The logo is sized as a fraction of figure height, so a small figure needs a
# smaller fraction.
add_cds_logo(add_watermark(p, date = data_through), height = 0.09)
```

`r h_row` Row

::: {.card title="By relying party (latest values)"}

```{r}
compare <- prior_period_complete(fid)

# The one stored window ending on data_through, like the overall row, so a
# service missing from it reads n/a rather than its last window from earlier.
# One row per GA rp_name: stored rates cannot be pooled. Each period is
# compared with the stored window just before it; the two never share a day.
latest_7d <- party_task_success(con, fid, "7", data_through, data_through) |>
  select(breakdown_value, rate_7d = value, starters_7d = starters)
prior_7d <- party_task_success(
  con, fid, "7", data_through - 7L, data_through - 7L
) |>
  select(breakdown_value, prior_7d = value, prior_starters_7d = starters)

counts_long <- party_task_success_long_window(con, fid, data_through) |>
  select(breakdown_value, rate_long = value, entered = starters, finished)
prior_long <- party_task_success_long_window(
  con, fid, data_through - long_window_days
) |>
  select(breakdown_value, prior_long = value, prior_entered = starters)

merged <- reduce(list(latest_7d, prior_7d, counts_long, prior_long),
                 full_join, by = "breakdown_value")

per_rp <- merged |>
  mutate(Service = rp_display_name(breakdown_value)) |>
  # The pooled labels are not services, and the tail of the list shuffles from
  # day to day.
  filter(!Service %in% pooled_rp_labels) |>
  arrange(desc(entered)) |>
  slice_head(n = party_rows) |>
  mutate(
    Operator = coalesce(service_operators(con, Service), ""),
    # Two GA names on one service would otherwise share a label.
    shared = duplicated(Service) | duplicated(Service, fromLast = TRUE),
    Service = if_else(shared, paste0(Service, " (", breakdown_value, ")"),
                      Service)
  ) |>
  select(Service, Operator, rate_7d, starters_7d, prior_7d, prior_starters_7d,
         rate_long, prior_long, prior_entered, entered, finished)

overall_7d <- task_success_latest(con, fid, "7", trailing_start, data_through)
overall_prior_7d <- task_success_latest(
  con, fid, "7", data_through - 7L, data_through - 7L
)
overall_prior_long <- task_success_long_window(
  con, fid, data_through - long_window_days
)

overall <- task_success_long_window(con, fid, data_through) |>
  transmute(
    Service = "All users",
    Operator = "",
    rate_7d = overall_7d$value,
    starters_7d = overall_7d$starters,
    prior_7d = overall_prior_7d$value,
    prior_starters_7d = overall_prior_7d$starters,
    rate_long = value,
    prior_long = overall_prior_long$value,
    prior_entered = overall_prior_long$starters,
    entered = starters, finished
  )

rows <- bind_rows(overall, per_rp) |>
  # The long change stays even with nothing to compare against: every row
  # reads as a dash and comparison_note() explains it.
  mutate(
    delta_7d = rate_7d - prior_7d,
    delta_long = if (compare) rate_long - prior_long else NA_real_,
    noise_7d = change_noise(rate_7d, starters_7d, prior_7d, prior_starters_7d),
    noise_long = change_noise(rate_long, entered, prior_long, prior_entered),
    rate_7d = rate_change_cell(
      rate_7d, delta_7d, is_meaningful_change(delta_7d, noise_7d)
    ),
    rate_long = rate_change_cell(
      rate_long, delta_long, is_meaningful_change(delta_long, noise_long)
    )
  ) |>
  select(Service, Operator, entered, finished, rate_7d, rate_long)

gt(rows) |>
  fmt_markdown(c(rate_7d, rate_long)) |>
  cols_align("right", c(rate_7d, rate_long)) |>
  fmt_number(c(entered, finished), decimals = 0) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "n/a") |>
  cols_label(
    entered = html(glue("Started<br>({long_window_label})")),
    finished = html(glue("Finished<br>({long_window_label})")),
    rate_7d = "7-day rate",
    rate_long = glue("{long_window_label} rate")
  ) |>
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_body(rows = 1)) |>
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = px(14),
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    table.border.top.style = "none"
  )
```
